thread:
alex: Heads up — our March invoice shows a ~38% increase in GPU spend in us-west-2 vs forecast. Looks correlated with the model-finetune jobs we've been running and some long tail inference. Can we discuss committing to any new capacity or reconfiguring pools?

maria: Linked the billing export: https://billing.internal.redwood/reports/2026-03-usw2 (internal). Quick ask: is this a one-off or sustained? any rough numbers? :eyes:

alex: Not one-off. Breakdown from cloud billing export: total GPU hours 18,000, reserved hours 0. Forecasted 13,000. Delta ~5k hours. Effective unit cost up ~27%. I'll paste snippet:
```
us-west-2 GPU-hours: 18000
on-demand cost: $2.40/hr
commit 1yr convertible: $1.50/hr
estimated savings if commit 1yr for 100 GPUs: ~$340k/year
```

jordan: Finance — we can consider a 1yr partial commit but need clear SLO on utilization. What's the minimum commit to get the price break? We also need capex vs opex conversation. cc @maria

maria: Infra note: we can convert some burst pools into reserved gpools. BUT network egress constraints in us-west-2 are hitting us — several nodes are underutilized because of cross-AZ traffic throttles. So commit alone might waste money.

sam: From ML: most heavy runs are spiky — nightly evals + weekly retraining. Suggest hybrid: 6-month commit for baseline 60% utilization + burst credits for peak. Also propose shifting some training to h1-region where per-hour is ~15% cheaper.

lee: SRE: we found 2 days of degraded instance launches due to a flaky VPC route table in us-west-2 that caused job retries and inflated hours. Logs: `Error: ENETUNREACH` on 2026-02-15 03:12-04:30. Fix is deployed but we need to adjust for wasted retries.

ops-bot: Billing alert: invoice spike > 25% threshold triggered (ID invo-78391).

jordan: If we commit, we need a refund/offset plan for wasted hours from the retry days. Can infra quantify wasted hours from incidents?

maria: I'll run query against job events and billing join. Preliminary: ~1.1k GPU-hours lost to retries + 600 hours due to long-tail idle sessions waiting for load balancer. I'll post a table by EOD.

alex: Proposed motion: ask for finance approval to sign a 6-month partial commit (200 A100-equivalent units) for us-west-2, combined with burst pool credits and a 30% contingency fund to cover incident waste. Net savings vs on-demand ~20% in year1. Approve? @jordan :thumbsup:

jordan: Need a clear PO with line items and expected savings, and a service credit clause for platform incidents. Put numbers and legal terms.

maria: Draft PO numbers:
- Commit: 200 units x 24h x 30d x 6mo = 86,400 unit-hours
- Committed rate: $1.60/hr
- On-demand rate: $2.40/hr
- Estimated cost commit: $138,240
- Equivalent on-demand: $207,360
- Gross savings: $69,120
Add conservative 20% for utilization & incident waste -> net savings: ~$55k
I'll attach calc sheet to the procurement ticket.

sam: Also recommend shifting 40% of scheduled retrains to eu-west-1 during maintenance window to lower unit cost and smooth utilization.

lee: Ops action: I'll add a runbook to auto-throttle job retries and exclude impacted windows from billing queries.

alex: Vote: alex ✅

maria: maria ✅

sam: sam ✅

jordan: jordan ⛔ — need legal to add SLAs for incident credits and a PO with cancellation terms. Put this in procurement queue; if legal approves, we can greenlight.

alex: OK — I'll open a procurement ticket and loop legal. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
